notes: Department lists built from: (1) the already-sourced minister portfolio notes in data/raw/states-mh-gj-ga.json (holder.notes), which this file treats as ground truth and does not re-verify; (2) for Goa, the official department directory at https://www.goa.gov.in/departments/ (fetched directly); (3) for Maharashtra and Gujarat, the standard GAD/Rules-of-Business department nomenclature cross-checked against the sourced 2025-26 portfolio allocations. Network constraints during this research pass: WebSearch quota was exhausted (shared session budget, consumed by parallel background agents), the Wikipedia API returned rate-limit errors on repeated queries, and www.maharashtra.gov.in / digitalgujarat.gov.in were unreachable (connection timeout) from this sandbox, so no live department-list page for Maharashtra or Gujarat could be fetched directly; those two states' lists rely on the sourced minister portfolios plus well-established public-record department nomenclature rather than a freshly fetched official portal page. Administrative Secretary positions (Additional Chief Secretary / Principal Secretary / Secretary) are deliberately OMITTED for every department in this file: IAS secretary-level postings change frequently via transfer orders and could not be confirmed against a live 2025-26 source in this pass (no working WebSearch, Wikipedia rate-limited, state portals unreachable) — per the schema's guidance, omitted rather than guessed. A follow-up pass with working WebSearch/portal access should add these. Some portfolios held only by Ministers of State with no overlapping senior-minister charge (e.g. Gujarat MSME, Sports, Cottage/Khadi/Rural Industries, Transport, Tribal Development) were still given department entities headed by that MoS position, per the actual sourced allocation. A few departments (e.g. Goa's core School/Higher/Technical Education directorates, confirmed to exist on the official Goa departments page) were NOT created here because no minister in the existing sourced data is recorded as holding that portfolio — creating them with a guessed headPositionId would have violated the 'reference existing ids, do not invent' rule; they should be added once the Council-of-Ministers file records who holds Education in each of these three states.
